question:
Today, Samantha went to the amusement park. Between what times could they have gone?
We know that:
Samantha woke up at 5am.
Hannah saw Samantha buying a phone at the electronics store from 5am to 7am.
James saw Samantha working out at the gym from 7am to 8am.
Richard saw Samantha working at the office from 8am to 11am.
Mark saw Samantha buying lunch at the deli from 11am to 2pm.
William saw Samantha buying a bike at the bike shop from 7pm to 8pm.
The amusement park was closed after 8pm.
Between what times could Samantha have gone to the amusement park?
Options:
(A) 2pm to 7pm
(B) 11am to 2pm
(C) 5am to 7am
(D) 7am to 8am

segments.text: We need to find time interval when Samantha could have gone to amusement park, given constraints: She was seen at various times doing other activities.
Also park closed after 8pm, so must be before 8pm.
Also she must be free (not seen elsewhere).
So she was at electronics store.
7pm-8pm: buying bike at bike shop (William saw).
Thus free times: 2pm-7pm (since after lunch until before bike shop).
Also maybe after 8pm? but park closed after 8pm, so can't after 8pm.
She woke up at 5am, so before 5am not possible.
